description: Compare two previews' semantics by testTag: which tags are only in one side, which moved, and which changed occupancy count. Identity is the authored testTag, not a positional ref, so a tag that stops resolving is reported rather than silently retargeted at different pixels. Requires live grant scope.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: catalog_diff_semantics
